title: Which conclusion follows?
stimulus: A community newsletter says: “The garden introduced a new watering schedule. The next harvest was larger, so the schedule caused the improvement.” Identify the observation, the causal inference, an alternative explanation, and additional evidence that would distinguish them.
structural_context: A causal argument in prose without computing tools.

hints.content: Identify the precise assertion you need to justify before proposing a solution.
Look for a change in assumptions that would make your proposed reasoning fail.

validation.reason: Synthetic design fixture; requires answer-key and source review before real assessment use.
